# Reserved Prefix `00-`

## Status

Accepted

## Context

A common convention is required across all IASI projects to clearly separate infrastructure artifacts from domain artifacts.

Many repositories contain auxiliary resources, templates, scripts, configuration files or generated artifacts that should not be considered part of the functional content.

Without a common convention, every repository ends up inventing its own structure.

## Decision

The numeric prefix `00-` is reserved for infrastructure.

Any file or directory beginning with `00-` has a special meaning for the framework or for the project structure.

It is not considered part of the functional or editorial sequence.

Examples:

```
00-common/
00-shared/
00-assets/
00-template.md
00-index.qmd
```

User artifacts should start at `01-`.

Examples:

```
01-introduction/
02-installation/
03-api/
```

## Consequences

This convention provides:

- predictable project structures;
- simpler discovery algorithms;
- separation between infrastructure and user content;
- consistent ordering across repositories;
- extensibility without additional configuration.

The convention applies to all IASI repositories unless a project explicitly documents a different rule.
